name: Server
summary: Docker with Compose, Podman, Buildah, rootless nerdctl and nginx.

steps.title: nerdctl
steps.script:
# nerdctl is not packaged by these distributions: the official nerdctl-full
# release for this CPU (nerdctl with containerd, BuildKit, RootlessKit and the
# CNI plugins), checked against the release's SHA256SUMS. In its own folder,
# with only nerdctl's tools linked into /usr/local/bin: Docker keeps its own
# containerd and runc. Kept once installed.
dir="$MONAD_ROOT/opt/monad/nerdctl"
if [ ! -x "$dir/bin/nerdctl" ]; then
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    aarch64|arm64) arch=arm64 ;;
    x86_64|amd64) arch=amd64 ;;
    *) echo "no nerdctl build for $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  url=$(curl -fsSL -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/releases/latest) || exit 1
  tag=${url##*/}
  printf '%s\n' "$tag" | grep -Eq '^v[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+$' || { echo "odd nerdctl release: $tag"; exit 1; }
  file="nerdctl-full-${tag#v}-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
  base="https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/releases/download/$tag"
  tmp=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
  echo "› Downloading nerdctl-full $tag (about 250 MB)"
  if ! curl -fsSL "$base/SHA256SUMS" -o "$tmp/SHA256SUMS" || ! curl -fsSL "$base/$file" -o "$tmp/$file"; then
    rm -rf "$tmp"; echo 'the nerdctl download failed'; exit 1
  fi
  if ! (cd "$tmp" && awk -v f="$file" '$2 == f' SHA256SUMS | grep -q . && awk -v f="$file" '$2 == f' SHA256SUMS | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null 2>&1); then
    rm -rf "$tmp"; echo 'the nerdctl download does not match its checksum'; exit 1
  fi
  rm -rf "$dir.part" && mkdir -p "$dir.part" && tar -xzf "$tmp/$file" -C "$dir.part" \
    || { rm -rf "$tmp" "$dir.part"; echo 'the nerdctl archive could not be unpacked'; exit 1; }
  rm -rf "$tmp"
  mv "$dir.part" "$dir" || exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "$MONAD_ROOT/usr/local/bin" || exit 1
for tool in nerdctl buildctl containerd-rootless-setuptool.sh; do
  ln -sfn "$dir/bin/$tool" "$MONAD_ROOT/usr/local/bin/$tool" || exit 1
done
# nerdctl looks for the CNI plugins in /opt/cni/bin first.
if [ ! -e "$MONAD_ROOT/opt/cni/bin" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$MONAD_ROOT/opt/cni" && ln -sfn "$dir/libexec/cni" "$MONAD_ROOT/opt/cni/bin" || exit 1
fi
# Ubuntu lets only programs AppArmor allows make user namespaces: rootlesskit,
# outside the distribution's own path, needs this profile.
if [ "$(cat "$MONAD_ROOT/proc/sys/kernel/apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns" 2>/dev/null)" = 1 ]; then
  aa="$MONAD_ROOT/etc/apparmor.d/opt.monad.nerdctl.bin.rootlesskit"
  cat > "$aa" <<'EOF'
abi <abi/4.0>,
include <tunables/global>

"/opt/monad/nerdctl/bin/rootlesskit" flags=(unconfined) {
  userns,

  include if exists <local/opt.monad.nerdctl.bin.rootlesskit>
}
EOF
  apparmor_parser -r "$aa" || { echo 'the AppArmor profile for rootlesskit could not be loaded'; exit 1; }
fi

steps.title: Services
steps.script:
# Docker and its containerd running, the login user in the docker group (from
# its next login), nginx serving.
systemctl enable --now containerd docker nginx
getent group docker >/dev/null && usermod -aG docker "$MONAD_USER"

steps.title: Rootless containerd for nerdctl
steps.script:
# nerdctl run by the login user is rootless: its own containerd and BuildKit,
# set up by nerdctl's tool as that user, running without a login (lingering).
user="$MONAD_USER"
entry=$(getent passwd "$user") || { echo "no user $user"; exit 1; }
uid=$(printf '%s' "$entry" | cut -d: -f3)
home=$(printf '%s' "$entry" | cut -d: -f6)
# Subordinate IDs: the containers' users map into them.
for kind in uid gid; do
  file="$MONAD_ROOT/etc/sub$kind"
  [ -f "$file" ] && grep -q "^$user:" "$file" && continue
  start=$(awk -F: 'BEGIN { m = 100000 } { e = $2 + $3; if (e > m) m = e } END { print m }' "$file" 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$start" ] || start=100000
  usermod "--add-sub${kind}s" "$start-$((start + 65535))" "$user" || { echo "cannot give $user subordinate ${kind}s"; exit 1; }
done
loginctl enable-linger "$user" || exit 1
i=0
while [ ! -e "$MONAD_ROOT/run/user/$uid/bus" ] && [ "$i" -lt 30 ]; do sleep 1; i=$((i + 1)); done
[ -e "$MONAD_ROOT/run/user/$uid/bus" ] || { echo "the user session of $user did not start"; exit 1; }
as_user() {
  runuser -u "$user" -- env HOME="$home" XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$uid" \
    DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=/run/user/$uid/bus" \
    PATH="/opt/monad/nerdctl/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" "$@"
}
if ! as_user systemctl --user is-active --quiet containerd.service; then
  echo "› Setting up rootless containerd for $user"
  as_user containerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install || exit 1
fi
if ! as_user systemctl --user is-active --quiet buildkit.service; then
  echo "› Setting up rootless BuildKit for $user"
  as_user containerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install-buildkit || exit 1
fi
